newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Shell Nigeria says reduced staff in Forcados area.
newsitem.headline: Shell Nigeria says reduced staff in Forcados area.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell Group's Nigerian unit said on Friday ethnic clashes had forced it to cut the number of staff in the Forcados area where oil output had been reduced by 20 percent and a force majeure declared on some cargoes due for lifting from April 29th.
"What has happened is that because of the skirmishes we have had to reduce staff exposure there and that is why some of the wells have been closed," a Shell spokesman told Reuters in Lagos.

Many people have been killed in fighting in the oil-producing swamps between militant youths of Ijaw and Itsekiri tribes over the relocation of a local council headquarters. The clashes forced Shell to close its Warri flow station last weekend.
The Shell spokesman said the exact number of staff withdrawn in the area was not yet known.
"Obviously because of the situation the fewer the personnel exposed the safer for all," he added.
